input.title: Hackathon radar · Tue Oct 27
input.content:
# Hackathon radar · Tue Oct 27

**Three things changed since yesterday.**

- **Rules:** the Devpost FAQ now requires a public GitHub repository with a visible MIT licence. Ours is MIT; the licence file must stay at the repo root.
- **Pace:** 41 of 312 started projects are submitted; the deadline is Oct 30, 10:00 PDT.
- **Competitor:** Bridge Bot (Mezo buildathon, Personal AI track) is a Telegram agent that drafts wallet transfers for approval: the same approval idea, one chat app, no crew, no learning.

## Who else is building a personal agent

| project | track | what it does | overlap with Nimbus |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridge Bot | Personal AI | Telegram agent for Mezo wallets, approval before each transfer | approvals only |
| Satoshi Pay | payments | pay links | none |
| Vault Kit | savings | recurring saves | none |

## Say differently

Lead with the crew and the learning loop, not "an agent with approvals": approvals are table stakes now.

*Source news: Token Factory bills cached input at $0.12 (Ultra) and $0.06 (Super) per 1M tokens; our role prompts are a stable prefix for exactly this.*
